caveat: Published 5 June 2026, outside the window. A single-author comparative argument built on a three-stage model rather than new empirical work.
title: From Biopiracy to Sustainable Knowledge Governance: Epistemic Justice and the Reconstruction of Resource Sovereignty in the Global South
why: Treats biopiracy as epistemic colonialism and compares India, Brazil and South Africa on rebuilding knowledge sovereignty. Concrete material for the Santos strand of the CARN workshop.
